[Guillaume Knight]
Tierra Gorge consists of two steep sides placed vertically, and has ration depots for the Guillaume and Croix Armies at the 11 and 7 o'clock directions.
scripts.translation: 蒂拉峽谷兩側是陡峭的巖壁，吉約姆軍團和克魯瓦軍團的補給倉庫分別位於11點和7點鐘方向。

scripts.text: [Guillaume Knight]
The battle starts at your army's ship, and the goal is to advance and destroy your enemy's rations depot faster than they can destroy yours.
scripts.translation: 戰鬥從己方軍船開始，目標是在敵人摧毀我方補給倉庫之前，先摧毀敵方的補給倉庫。

scripts.text: [Guillaume Knight]
The healer of the battlefield will resurrect soldiers once every 25 seconds so that they can rejoin the battle.
scripts.translation: 戰場治療師每25秒會復活士兵，讓他們重返戰場。

scripts.text: The army that captures the neutral flag in the center of the battlefield will be rewarded with extra regeneration points, meaning their soldiers will resurrect more than the other side, giving them an advantage.
scripts.translation: 佔領戰場中央的中立旗幟，可以獲得額外的復活點，讓更多士兵復活，從而取得優勢。

scripts.text: [Guillaume Knight]
Those two rations depots are connected to each other through short and narrow paths, but the gates are blocked with barricades.
scripts.translation: 兩座補給倉庫由幾條狹窄的小路相連，但入口被路障封鎖。

scripts.text: Think and move as quickly as you can. The victory of your army relies on your contribution.
scripts.translation: 請迅速判斷、果斷行動，你的表現關係到整個軍團的勝敗。

scripts.text: [Guillaume Knight]
If you are ready, start by clicking the ^0000FFbattle button from the interface^000000.
scripts.translation: 準備好後，請點選^0000FF介面上的戰鬥按鈕^000000開始。

scripts.text: Please remember: when you join a battle, you will receive a token which indicates the set duration for which you cannot participate in the same type of battle.
scripts.translation: 請記住，參加戰鬥後你會獲得一個標記，顯示再次參加同類戰鬥前必須等待的時間。

scripts.text: You may check the duration by pressing the Alt+U keys.
[Guillaume Knight]
Please bear in mind once you cancel, ^0000FFyou may not reapply for 1 minute^000000!
scripts.translation: 請注意，取消申請後，^0000FF1分鐘內不能重新申請^000000！

scripts.text: Are you ready to battle? Then apply with the recruiter next to me!
scripts.translation: 準備好戰鬥了嗎？去找我旁邊的招募員報名吧！
